verdict.rationale: Reducto's Parse docs say it handles "forms with handwriting" and that each element includes its type, page position, and a confidence score. Extract runs OCR and LLM-based field location underneath, and citations return bounding boxes per extracted field. Together these cover recognizing and extracting handwritten fields with a confidence signal, but handwriting appears only as a single mention. Missing for 10: explicit support for annotations or margin markup, an explicit low-confidence flag or threshold on extracted fields, dedicated handwriting documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of handwriting accuracy.
